author: alja
body:
Fix failures in test reported in #5245

test_dumpRecoGeometry.sh discovered Run4 versions from the GeometryExtendedRun4D*Reco* files only, so geometries without an entry in upgradeProperties['Run4'] (e.g. D500) made dumpRecoGeometry_cfg.py fail with a KeyError. Such versions are now skipped with a message.

The exit status of the background cmsRun jobs was also never checked, so failures did not fail the test. Each job's PID is now waited on and the script exits non-zero, listing the failed versions.
title: Fireworks/Geometry: skip unregistered Run4 geometries and catch job failures
